gameBase.intro: This is a hotfix update. Replay codes from the August 11 patch are still available.

changes.title: Fixed a bug with Portable Fusion Repeater that could result in hits failing to register.
details: Fixed a bug with Portable Fusion Repeater that could result in hits failing to register.
Fixed a bug with Limit Break not correctly granting Overhealth for targets hit.
Fixed in a previous update - Resolved an issue that prevented Overhealth from being applied when Limit Break was activated.
Fixed a bug where Toggle Propulsors did not work on console platforms.

changes.title: Hitbox Changes
details: Fixed an issue with being damaged from the front with while Power Barrier was deployed.
Adjusted the height of the mech head hitbox to be more flush with the model.

changes.title: Surging Strike
details: Cast Time reduced from 0.15 to 0.05 seconds.

changes.title: Fusion Repeater
details: Cast Time reduced from 0.3 to 0.2 seconds.
Recovery Time reduced from 0.5 to 0.2 seconds.

changes.title: Base movement speed reduced from 6 to 5.5 meters per second.
details: Base movement speed reduced from 6 to 5.5 meters per second.

changes.title: Purr
details: Self healing penalty increased from 25% to 40%.
